name: Mo' Bettahs Hawaiian Style Kalua Pig with Steamed White Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Mo' Bettahs Hawaiian Style (Draper / Lehi / Herriman)
whyItWorks: Slow-roasted, tender shredded pork shoulder seasoned with sea salt and liquid smoke, served over scoops of steaming white rice. Extremely tender, dairy-free, and virtually zero insoluble roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Mini or Regular plate with Kalua Pig and double white rice. Skip the macaroni salad (heavy mayo/dairy) and teri sauce.
